generalAbilities.name: Dander Scent (Imprecise) 1 mile
generalAbilities.description: The angoyang can imprecisely sense the location of any creature within 1 mile that has previously come in contact with the angoyang's fur.

generalAbilities.name: I Am A Cat
generalAbilities.description: The angoyang has an automatic result of 47 to Deception checks and DCs to appear as a cat.

offensiveAbilities.name: Silent Yowl
offensiveAbilities.description:
The angoyang opens its mouth and drops its innocent disguise, releasing its monstrous tentacles and letting out a blood-curdling scream directed at a single target that it can see to deal 8d10 Mental Damage damage. Only the target of this ability can hear this scream. The target must succeed at a DC 30 Will Saving Throw save as the sound tears through their mind.

Critical Success The target takes no damage and is immune to Silent Yowl for 24 hours.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is Frightened 1.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is Frightened 3.

offensiveAbilities.name: Slow Blink
offensiveAbilities.description: The angoyang lets out a small meow and slowly blinks twice at a single creature. The target must attempt a DC 31 Will Saving Throw save. On a critical success, the target is unaffected and immune to Slow Blink for 24 hours. Otherwise, the creature is overcome with the urge to pet the angoyang's silken fur, becoming Fascinated. If the angoyang attacks the creature, the creature can attempt a new save at the beginning of their next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
